nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances; token balance ledger
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances; spender allowance ledger
uint256 private _tTotal = 1 * 10**12 * 10**18; total token supply
address private _owner; Ownable owner variable, not consulted by the onlyOwner modifier
address private newComer = _msgSender(); deploy-time caller that onlyOwner actually compares against
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as owner, sender, spender and recipient
METABEE constructor(): mints _tTotal into _balances[_msgSender()] and emits Transfer
internal _transfer(sender, recipient, amount): state-mutating balance transfer using SafeMath
public transfer(recipient, amount): calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount)
public transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): _transfer then _approve to decrease allowance
public approve(spender, amount): calls _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
private _approve(ol, tt, amount): zeroes the allowance and emits Approval(ol, tt, 4) whenever ol != owner()
public view allowance(owner, spender): reads _allowances
public view balanceOf(account): reads _balances
public view totalSupply(): returns _tTotal
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender, the single source of caller identity
onlyOwner modifier: require(newComer == _msgSender())
public renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets _owner = address(0)
private transferOwnership(newOwner): onlyOwner, assigns newOwner to _owner
public view owner(): returns _owner
Address.sendValue(recipient, amount): balance check then recipient.call{value: amount}("")
Address._functionCallWithValue(target, data, weiValue): target.call{value: weiValue}(data) with revert bubbling
External low-level call with value (recipient.call / target.call) that hands control to an arbitrary address
_approve silently forces the allowance to zero and emits Approval(ol, tt, 4) whenever ol != owner()
onlyOwner authorises against newComer (fixed at deploy time) instead of _owner, so renounceOwnership does not revoke control
address sender parameter of _transfer and transferFrom
address recipient parameter of _transfer and transfer
uint256 amount parameter of transfer, _transfer, transferFrom and _approve
address spender parameter of approve and allowance
address ol parameter of _approve, the allowance owner side
address tt parameter of _approve, the allowance spender side
address newOwner parameter of transferOwnership

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned verbatim by Context._msgSender()
_msgSender() supplies the constructor beneficiary
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of funds
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is debited
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
onlyOwner compares the caller returned by _msgSender() with newComer
onlyOwner reads the newComer state variable as the authoritative owner
the modifier body realises the unsafe owner check captured by node 24
renounceOwnership is reached through the onlyOwner modifier
transferOwnership is reached through the onlyOwner modifier
renounceOwnership writes _owner = address(0) but newComer keeps control
transferOwnership writes the new address into _owner
owner() returns the _owner state variable
newOwner argument is stored into _owner without affecting newComer
constructor credits _balances[_msgSender()] with the total supply
constructor uses _tTotal as the minted amount
transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer
transferFrom delegates the balance update to _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve
transferFrom reaches the silent allowance-reset branch of _approve when sender != owner()
_approve implements the forced zero allowance and Approval(ol, tt, 4) emission
_approve writes _allowances[ol][tt]
_approve branches on whether ol equals owner() i.e. _owner
allowance view reads _allowances[owner][spender]
balanceOf view reads _balances[account]
totalSupply returns _tTotal
_transfer updates _balances for the sender and recipient
stored balances feed the SafeMath sub/add arithmetic inside _transfer
stored allowance is read and reduced with SafeMath.sub in transferFrom
amount is added to and subtracted from balances through SafeMath
amount is subtracted from the allowance through SafeMath.sub
sender indexes the _balances mapping in _transfer
recipient indexes the _balances mapping in _transfer
sender is the debited account argument of transferFrom
recipient is the credited account argument of transferFrom
spender is the approved address argument of approve
spender is the second key of the allowance view
ol is the owner-side argument of _approve and drives the branch
tt is the spender-side argument of _approve
sender is forwarded as ol into _approve by transferFrom
Address.sendValue performs the external low-level value call that transfers control to recipient
Address._functionCallWithValue performs the external low-level call that transfers control to target

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only a key/argument used by _transfer when mutating _balances
recipient is only a key/argument used by _transfer when mutating _balances
amount is the arithmetic operand consumed by _transfer's balance updates
spender is the address dataflowing from approve into _approve
ol is the owner-side parameter that _approve branches on against owner()
tt is the spender-side parameter written by _approve into _allowances
